Another outstanding historical landmark of Khulo is Khikhani Fortress, one of the most significant medieval defensive structures in the region. Built on a high rocky mountain at approximately 2,200 metres above sea level, the fortress benefited from a naturally protected position and held important strategic value.

Khikhani Fortress is closely connected with the historical past of Adjara and served as an important defensive point controlling mountain routes. It represents the era when mountain fortresses were not only places of protection but also symbols of political influence and regional power.

Today, Khikhani Fortress is a remarkable destination for those interested in history, hiking, and authentic discoveries. The journey to the fortress, surrounded by dramatic mountain landscapes and panoramic views, becomes an unforgettable adventure in itself.

Travelling through Khulo is especially rewarding for those seeking authentic experiences discovering mountain village life, connecting with nature, exploring local stories, and experiencing a region that remains far from mass tourism.

This is a place where visitors do not come merely to see; they come to discover, to feel, and to experience a part of Georgia where traditions are still an essential part of everyday life.

Discover Khulo with us travel through the breathtaking landscapes of mountainous Adjara, admire the beauty of the Caucasus Mountains, experience the traditions of highland villages, and discover a unique corner of Georgia where nature, history, and genuine hospitality come together in one unforgettable journey.

kobuleti.name: ქობულეთი
kobuleti.description:
Kobuleti is one of Adjara's most beloved seaside destinations, especially popular among families seeking a peaceful and comfortable holiday by the Black Sea. Its wide coastline, mild climate, relaxed atmosphere, and welcoming seaside environment have attracted visitors for decades.

However, the true character of Kobuleti extends far beyond its beaches. Behind the coastline lies a completely different world ancient forests, protected areas, historical landmarks, traditional villages, and places where travellers can discover the authentic everyday life of Adjara.

One of Kobuleti's greatest treasures is its unique natural diversity. Here, the Black Sea coastal ecosystem meets the ancient world of Colchian forests. The Mtirala National Park, with its mist-covered mountains, waterfalls, rivers, and rich vegetation, is one of Georgia's most remarkable natural destinations. It is an ideal place for those who enjoy hiking, eco-tourism, and exploring untouched landscapes.

The natural heritage of Kobuleti is further enriched by the Kintrishi Protected Areas, where pristine forests, mountain rivers, and breathtaking landscapes create a peaceful and inspiring environment. Here, visitors can discover a quieter and lesser-known side of Adjara a destination perfect for those seeking authentic experiences away from crowded tourist routes.

Another important natural treasure is the Ispani Marsh, a unique wetland ecosystem distinguished by its exceptional biodiversity. The area is particularly significant for birdwatching, attracting nature enthusiasts during seasonal bird migrations and offering a rare opportunity to observe the delicate balance of coastal ecosystems.

The history of Kobuleti reaches back through many centuries. This region was once part of the ancient world of Colchis and has long served as a meeting point of different cultures and civilizations. The Petra Fortress, built in the 6th century, is one of the most significant historical landmarks on the Adjara coastline. Due to its strategic location, the fortress played an important role throughout history, and today it offers visitors the opportunity to experience the heritage of the Byzantine era while enjoying spectacular views over the Black Sea.

The unique charm of Kobuleti can also be found in its villages and local traditions. In places such as Mukhaestate and other surrounding villages, visitors can discover traditional Adjara lifestyles, meet local families, experience rural hospitality, and learn about local products and customs that have been passed down through generations.

Kobuleti offers the opportunity to combine different experiences within one journey - relaxing on the Black Sea coast, exploring natural wonders, discovering historical landmarks, and connecting with local culture.

Kobuleti a place where the tranquillity of the sea meets the beauty of Colchian nature, where history blends with modern travel, and where every road leads to a new discovery.

Discover Kobuleti with us relax on the Black Sea coast, uncover hidden stories, explore ancient forests and protected landscapes, and experience the authentic spirit of Adjara that continues to live through its nature, traditions, and people.

machakhela.name: მაჭახელა
machakhela.description:
Not far from Batumi begins a journey into a completely different world the Machakhela Valley, where green mountains, a peaceful river gorge, ancient villages, and traditions preserved through centuries create a truly unique atmosphere.

Machakhela is a historic region that for centuries existed as a united cultural space. Today, its territory is divided between Georgia and Turkiye, yet modern borders have not changed the essence of this land its shared history, cultural heritage, traditions, and the deep connection of its people with their homeland remain alive.

Here, history is not preserved only in books or museums it continues to live in traditional villages, old houses, local craftsmanship, and in the stories of people who pass the memory of this valley from one generation to the next.

One of Machakhela's greatest treasures is its remarkable natural beauty. Following the Machakhela River, the road leads travellers through magnificent mountains, forests, valleys, and small villages where every corner carries its own story. Far from mass tourism, the region offers a peaceful and authentic atmosphere where visitors can experience the true spirit of Adjara.

Among the valley's natural wonders, the Mirveti Waterfall stands out as one of its most beautiful destinations. Hidden among green forests, the waterfall creates a peaceful and unforgettable landscape where cascading waters meet untouched nature. Mirveti is more than a scenic attraction it is a place where visitors can walk through ancient forests, enjoy fresh mountain air, and experience a deep connection with the natural environment.

Machakhela holds a special place in Georgia's cultural heritage due to its famous craftsmanship. For centuries, the valley was known for the traditional art of Machakhela gun-making. Local masters created highly crafted works that were not simply weapons, but examples of artistic skill, knowledge, and exceptional craftsmanship.

Today, this tradition continues to live. Visitors to Machakhela can meet local craftsmen, hear the stories behind this unique heritage, learn about the traditional production process, and even participate in special masterclasses. Such encounters reveal the dedication, experience, and generations of knowledge behind each creation, transforming a simple visit into a meaningful cultural experience.

The historical and cultural identity of Machakhela is further enriched by its old mosques and ethnographic heritage. A mosque with nearly two centuries of history, which now houses the Machakhela Ethnographic Museum, reflects the region's diverse past and the coexistence of different cultural influences and traditions. The museum preserves objects of local daily life, examples of traditional crafts, and materials that help visitors better understand the history and lifestyle of this unique region.

Another important historical landmark of Machakhela is Gvara Fortress. This ancient defensive structure recalls the period when the valley played an important strategic role, controlling significant routes and connecting different parts of the region. Visiting the fortress allows travellers to touch the historical layers that shaped the identity of Machakhela.

Yet the greatest treasure of Machakhela remains its people. Local families, genuine hospitality, traditional cuisine, and stories passed down through generations create an atmosphere that can only be discovered through authentic travel experiences.

Machakhela is a destination for those who wish to discover Georgia beyond the well-known tourist routes a place where nature, history, craftsmanship, and living culture come together.

Discover Machakhela with us walk through its breathtaking valleys, experience the beauty of Mirveti Waterfall, explore centuries of history, meet local masters, and discover the authentic spirit of one of Adjara's most remarkable cultural regions.

goderdzi.name: გოდერძი
goderdzi.description:
Located in the highlands of Adjara, at an altitude of more than 2,000 metres above sea level, Goderdzi is one of Georgia's most distinctive mountain resorts, offering visitors breathtaking nature, fresh mountain air, and unforgettable experiences throughout the year.

Goderdzi reveals its special charm during the winter season, when snow-covered mountains, spectacular landscapes, and modern ski infrastructure transform the resort into an attractive destination for winter sports enthusiasts.

The resort is known for its ski slopes, designed for both beginners and experienced skiers. Modern cable cars and well-prepared pistes provide visitors with a safe and comfortable skiing experience. The Goderdzi ski area meets contemporary European standards and is especially appealing for those seeking quality winter holidays surrounded by the unique natural beauty of Georgia.

One of Goderdzi's greatest advantages is its exceptional location, where the proximity of the Black Sea coast and the landscapes of the high Caucasus mountains come together. Unlike many other mountain resorts, Goderdzi offers more than snow and winter activities it provides an authentic mountain atmosphere, breathtaking views, and opportunities to discover the traditions and lifestyle of highland Adjara.

However, Goderdzi is not only a winter destination. During the warmer months, the resort transforms completely. Snow-covered slopes give way to green alpine meadows, colourful mountain flowers, fresh air, and magnificent views of the Caucasus Mountains.

In summer, Goderdzi becomes an ideal destination for those seeking tranquillity, outdoor adventures, and a closer connection with nature. Visitors can explore mountain trails, travel through alpine landscapes, enjoy photography, and discover breathtaking views where endless horizons open before them.

One of the most memorable summer experiences in Goderdzi is the Alpine Botanical Garden, remarkable attractions, offering visitors the opportunity to explore the unique flora of the high mountains, enjoy spectacular views, and experience the natural beauty of Adjara's alpine landscapes.

Nearby, the Green Lake becomes one of the most attractive destinations during the summer season. Located in a high mountain environment, the lake is admired for its distinctive colour, crystal-clear water, and peaceful atmosphere. It is a place where visitors can slow down, reconnect with nature, and experience the pure beauty of the mountains.

Goderdzi is especially attractive for hiking, eco-tourism, photography, and nature lovers a destination where every season brings a new discovery.

Discover Goderdzi with us enjoy the beauty of snow-covered mountains, experience modern ski slopes, admire the landscapes of the Caucasus, and discover the unique atmosphere of one of Georgia's most fascinating mountain resorts.

adjaraCoastline.name: აჭარის სანაპირო
adjaraCoastline.description:
Stretching south from Batumi along the Black Sea coast, Sarpi, Gonio, and Kvariati form one of Adjara's most attractive seaside areas, known for their beautiful beaches, warm waters, and ideal atmosphere for relaxation.

These neighbouring coastal destinations are especially popular among travellers who seek a true seaside experience. Here, visitors can enjoy the beauty of the Black Sea, spend peaceful days on the beach, and take part in a variety of marine activities.

Sarpi, Gonio, and Kvariati offer diverse coastal experiences from exciting water activities such as jet skiing, parasailing, and other sea adventures to fishing and relaxing moments by the shore. For those who wish to experience the sea in a different way, various water activities provide the opportunity to explore the open waters and enjoy unforgettable views of the coastline.

Kvariati is particularly known for its clean sea water and distinctive beach atmosphere. Compared with Batumi's central coastline, Kvariati features smaller and more comfortable pebbles, clearer waters, and a more peaceful environment. This makes it one of the favourite destinations for visitors seeking a comfortable and relaxing seaside holiday.

Kvariati is an excellent choice both for families and groups of friends. The area offers a variety of seaside facilities, including coastal cafes, bars, bungalows, and entertainment spaces, allowing visitors to enjoy both relaxing days and lively evenings by the sea.

Gonio combines seaside relaxation with an active resort atmosphere. Its spacious beach, comfortable environment, and close location to Batumi make it one of the most popular summer destinations in Adjara. At the same time, the historic Gonio Fortress offers visitors the opportunity to combine a beach holiday with a journey into the ancient history of the region.

Sarpi, the southernmost coastal settlement of Adjara, is distinguished by its unique natural scenery. The close connection between the sea and mountains, rocky coastline, and dramatic landscapes give this place a special character and atmosphere.

Together, Sarpi, Gonio, and Kvariati represent the southern coastline of Adjara a place where clear waters, beautiful beaches, and modern seaside facilities create the perfect environment for relaxation and unforgettable memories.

Discover the southern coast of Adjara with us enjoy the beauty of the Black Sea, experience exciting marine activities, relax on comfortable beaches, and feel the unique summer atmosphere of Sarpi, Gonio, and Kvariati.
